scenes.title: Жизнь в столице  (Life in the Capital)
scenes.summary: At Claude Monet early in the morning, Max tells Kostya about his first two weeks in Moscow and boasts about living in the city center for free.

scenes.title: Секретный жилец  (The Secret Resident)
scenes.summary: Kostya arrives early at Claude Monet and catches Max in casual clothes, discovering that Max has been secretly sleeping overnight in the restaurant.

scenes.title: Соседи по квартире  (Roommates)
scenes.summary: Sympathizing with Max's homeless predicament, Kostya offers him a spare bedroom in his apartment, and Max gladly accepts after clarifying that his romance with Nastya was fake.

scenes.title: Уксус и воровство  (Vinegar and Theft)
scenes.summary: Fedya catches Senya secretly stealing culinary vinegar in the kitchen, and the two rush to prepare meat before Chef Barinov returns.

scenes.title: Встреча на рынке  (Meeting at the Market)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov runs into his culinary rival Elena at the food market, trading sharp remarks over produce and restaurant menus.

scenes.title: Покупка ножа  (Buying a Knife)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov visits a specialized cutlery stall at the food market, negotiating a deal for a genuine Japanese chef knife.

scenes.title: Спасение карпов  (Saving the Carp)
scenes.summary: In the quiet restaurant back area, waitress Nastya tearfully tells Kostya that her strict landlady threw her out after finding live carp in the bathtub. Sympathizing with her, Kostya warmly invites Nastya to stay at his apartment.

scenes.title: Совет от Макса  (Advice from Max)
scenes.summary: In the dining room, Max is shocked to learn that Kostya invited Nastya to move into their shared flat. Determined to preserve his living space, Max humorously dissuades Nastya by inventing a story about Kostya's loud snoring.

scenes.title: Дегустация соуса  (Tasting the Sauce)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov summons the kitchen brigade to sample his newly invented gourmet sauce, basking in their unanimous praise.

scenes.title: Произведение искусства  (A Work of Art)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov presents his signature dish to restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev, proudly boasting that the sauce is a culinary masterpiece.

scenes.title: Хвалёный соус  (The Praised Sauce)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev drops by to taste Chef Barinov's much-praised signature sauce. Before taking a bite, Dmitry accidentally drops his bread and rushes off to an urgent meeting, promising to return for dinner.

scenes.title: Только правда  (Nothing But the Truth)
scenes.summary: After discovering that his wine sauce actually tasted terrible, Chef Barinov furiously lines up the kitchen staff. Outraged that his cooks flattered him instead of being honest, he demands that everyone tell him the absolute truth from now on.

scenes.title: Предательство друга  (A Friend's Betrayal)
scenes.summary: Kostya discovers that Max secretly told Nastya he was a crazy snorer, and furiously confronts his roommate about the betrayal.

scenes.title: Командная работа  (Teamwork)
scenes.summary: Having burned his tongue with vinegar and lost his sense of taste, Chef Barinov is saved when the cooks offer to taste the sauces for him.

scenes.title: Правда отменяется  (The Truth Is Canceled)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Chef Barinov genuinely praises Max's dish, before cheekily declaring that the day of blunt honesty is officially over and thanking him.

scenes.title: Предложение соседа  (A Roommate Offer)
scenes.summary: At the restaurant bar, bartender Kostya hears that Max has nowhere to live in Moscow and offers him a spare room in his rented apartment with an elderly landlady.

scenes.title: В гостях у Кости  (Visiting Kostya)
scenes.summary: Nastya visits Kostya's rented apartment to see his living space. But when she spots a dead mouse in a trap on the floor, the passionate animal lover is horrified and brands Kostya a monster.

scenes.title: Визит к Луи  (A Visit to Louis)
scenes.summary: Looking for a place to stay the night, Max knocks on pastry chef Louis's door. Confusing Max's visit for a romantic advance, Louis gently lets him down and slams the door.

scenes.title: Звонок Косте  (Call to Kostya)
scenes.summary: Stranded on the street with flowers after Louis rejection, Max calls Kostya to explain the practical joke and ask for a place to sleep.

scenes.title: Куда вернуться  (A Place to Come Home To)
scenes.summary: Reunited with Kostya at his apartment, Max reflects on the chaotic day and realizes the supreme importance of having a home where people are glad to see you.
